01-hook.text: Running alone? You skip, nobody notices, and you quit.

02-find.text: On Well Circle you find your crew, like the Bertusew running club.

03-join.text: Join the circle and save your spot for Sunday.

04-points.text: Show up and check in, then post your run. Each one earns ten points.

05-cheer.text: Cheer the crew on with reactions, comments and gifted points.

06-spend.text: Then spend your points on a post-run massage.

07-cta.text: Find your crew on Well Circle.
